note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: cinatra#2817 (PR #2914 carries this record): version- and declaration-bound delegated-chat admission adds FIVE new first-party modules and deletes none — packages/mcp-server/src/capability-plan.ts, packages/mcp-server/src/delegated-chat-admission.ts, packages/mcp-server/src/core-delegated-chat-surface.ts, src/lib/delegated-chat-admission-store.ts and src/lib/extension-authorized-dispatch.ts. Four of the five are reachable from every locked route that mounts the MCP surface, which is exactly the +4 here; core-delegated-chat-surface.ts derives the frozen-name projection for the non-widening arm and is not route-reachable. This is the MEASURED floor, not the first number: four consolidations already folded the original eight new modules down to these five (host-primitive-identity.ts + host-primitive-declarations.ts into capability-plan.ts, delegated-chat-evaluator.ts into delegated-chat-admission.ts, delegated-chat-admission-generation.ts into extension-activation-generation.ts). The fifth fold, extension-authorized-dispatch.ts into extension-edge-bound-serving.ts, was attempted and REVERTED: it collapses the seam that pins two version-crossing refusals, and the only remaining candidate would buy one module at the cost of a 1,336-line security file. Measured with the companion extension repos cloned pinned, on the tree merged with origin/main, against origin/main's own baseline.

/sign-in.reason: cinatra#2911 (PR #2919 carries this record): agent_runs.created_at bootstrap backfill moved to a DDL leaf imported by drizzle-store (#2911) — src/lib/agent-run-created-at-schema.ts. The unguarded whole-table `UPDATE ... SET created_at = COALESCE(started_at, completed_at, created_at)` that stood inline in buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries is replaced by three idempotent statements in their own zero-import leaf (add the column NULLABLE, backfill ONLY `created_at IS NULL`, then restore DEFAULT now() + NOT NULL), so a replay of the bootstrap can no longer recompute a run's creation time from columns populated later in its life. The leaf is reached only from src/lib/drizzle-store.ts, which sits under the store graph every locked route reaches, so it is +1 on each of them. It imports NOTHING (a pure string builder, the same leaf shape as review-island-grant-schema.ts): the edge is one module, not a barrel. Measured with the companion extension repos cloned pinned (112/112) on this branch and, as the control, on origin/main (269ceb19449dfa1ba7ed436aef132a59de28f9ae) — the control reproduced the committed main ceilings exactly and the branch measured +1 on each of the five tracked routes.
